intro:
A shimmer placeholder for content that has not loaded yet.

Size it with Tailwind utilities, matching the shape of what is coming — a placeholder that is the wrong size moves the page when the real content lands.

For a shimmer over content that *is* there, use [Shimmer](/docs/components/shimmer).
usage:
<View className="flex-row items-center gap-3">
  <Skeleton className="h-12 w-12 rounded-full" />
  <View className="flex-1 gap-2">
    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-3/4" />
    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-1/2" />
  </View>
</View>

examples.title: A loading card
examples.description: Match the shape of the real content — a skeleton that is the wrong size is worse than none, because the layout jumps when the data lands.
examples.code:
<Card>
  <Card.Content className="gap-3 p-4">
    <Skeleton className="h-5 w-1/2" />
    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-full" />
    <Skeleton className="h-4 w-4/5" />
  </Card.Content>
</Card>
